bullets.text: A road collapse near a metro site on Old Mahabalipuram Road swallowed an SUV into a 10-foot sinkhole, leaving occupants unharmed.
Chennai police detained over 30 protesters in Besant Nagar during demonstrations in solidarity with the CJP Delhi protests demanding the CEC resignation.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi is visiting Chennai tomorrow under a five-tier security deployment of 22,000 police personnel for development project launches.
Minister Kumar stated in Ponneri that pre-disaster management works to tackle the northeast monsoon have been successfully completed.
Minister Kumar inaugurated 24 battery-operated garbage collection vehicles worth 48 lakh rupees across 21 panchayats in Gummidipoondi.
SDPI condemned the TVK government for democratic violations and the crackdown on peaceful protests in Chennai following Besant Nagar detentions.
Dozens of youth demanding Gyanesh Kumar resignation were detained by Chennai police during SIR protests in Besant Nagar.
The Chennai Meteorological Department announced that the northeast monsoon is likely to begin in Tamil Nadu on October 17, 2026.
Southern Railway tendered a 1,546.69 crore project for fifth and sixth new rail lines between Villivakkam and Ambattur to develop Perambur as a fourth terminal.
Motorists faced health hazards as garbage was burned along the Ponneri-Minjur state highway due to a lack of proper waste management infrastructure.
Arani police arrested a person smuggling ganja bundles in a lorry near Periyapalayam and produced him before the Ponneri magistrate.
The Metropolitan Transport Corporation announced feeder bus services across 11 stations along the Poonamallee-Vadapalani metro corridor.
Reliance Jio is set to establish a massive 37-megawatt AI Data Centre and technology complex in Siruseri, Chennai.
Union IT Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw announced that the central government will release a draft consultation paper on AI regulations within 30 days.
Construction work on a 12-storey TIDEL Park spanning approximately 6.40 lakh square feet is progressing rapidly near Mattuthavani in Madurai.
DMK President M.K. Stalin accused the TVK government of acting as an extension of the BJP by unleashing police repression on protesting students.
Opposition leader Udhayanidhi Stalin criticized Chief Minister Vijay for deploying police to suppress peaceful protests by youth in Besant Nagar against the CEC.
DMK MP Kanimozhi alleged that the TVK government in Tamil Nadu suppressed protests in a manner mirroring the BJP-led government.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi will visit Chennai to inaugurate the Poonamallee to Porur metro rail service and launch other infrastructure development projects.
